programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    top = [list(grid[r]) + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)]
    bottom = [counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(n)]
    return top + bottom
'''
prog.write_text(code)
ns={}
exec(compile(code,str(prog),'exec'),ns)
fit=ns['transform'](inp)
print('demo match?', fit==out)
